tools.name: workflow_catalog
tools.description: Read the first decision-workflow preview, proposed price and measured evaluation status. No order, purchase or model call.

tools.name: kit_catalog
tools.description: Find work-kit previews. These kits are awaiting evaluation and cannot be purchased. Query using general task words, never private scenarios.

tools.name: research_preview
tools.description: Read future hosted research scopes and cost policy. No executable quote, payment or job is created.

tools.name: research_feedback
tools.description: Submit optional research interest or skill feedback. Use a random pseudonym; omit private scenarios, names, contact details and credentials. No order or payment. Raw feedback retained 30 days.

tools.name: catalog
tools.description: List available free methods, decision packs, and prices.

tools.name: method
tools.description: Read a free method by exact catalog ID. Returns provenance and limitations.

tools.name: sample_pack
tools.description: Free complete vendor-evaluation pack. No payment or account needed.

tools.name: pack_offer
tools.description: Get a payable HTTP URL and price by pack ID. Does not pay, buy, or authorize spending.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "research_feedback" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Submit optional research interest or skill feedback. Use a random pseudonym; omit private scenarios, names, contact details and credentials. No order or payment…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pack_offer · Private data: kit_catalog, research_feedback · Public sink: research_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pack_offer · Private data: kit_catalog, research_feedback · Public sink: research_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
